name: Streaming Normalization
description: Normalize streaming responses across all providers into a single event stream contract. Each provider's streaming API (SSE, WebSocket, chunked) is adapted into a unified sequence of events: token, partialToolCall, error, done, progress. Consumers receive a consistent AsyncIterable regardless of backend.
purpose: Provide a uniform streaming interface that hides provider-specific streaming formats, enabling streaming applications to work identically across all backends.
acceptanceCriteria: Unified stream event types: token, partialToolCall, delta, error, done, progress
Each provider has a streaming adapter that converts native format to unified events
Adapters handle: OpenAI SSE, Anthropic SSE, Google Gemini SSE, AWS Bedrock chunked
Unified stream is an AsyncIterable for easy consumption
Backpressure respected — consumer signals when to pause/resume
Stream cancellation propagates to provider's cancel mechanism
Partial tool calls accumulated and emitted as complete tool call on done
Timing metadata per event (receivedAt, latency since request start)
